known_limitations: corpus_only: no web, no external sources, no model memory as evidence
citation coverage debt ~0.88 inherited from the generator; not improved by this layer
production rejection rate inherited: roughly 1 request in 24 returns nothing
literal-span extraction is lexical, so paraphrase and cross-lingual answers yield notes marked INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with review_status=needs_manual_literal_span rather than SUPPORTED
packet-local [E###] handles are meaningless without context_packet_sha; every ref carries both plus a stable SRC- key
compound claims can be credited by a span covering only one clause; manual review still required for high-risk technical claims
conflict detection is not automated in v1: conflicting sources are representable but no detector proposes conflict groups
source authority is heterogeneous across the corpus and is not weighted
no final prose has been produced or evaluated
